headline: Executive order directs the government to fit new financial technology into its rules for banks and financial services.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how federal financial regulators handle financial technology, often called fintech. It appears aimed at bringing new fintech products and companies into existing regulatory systems. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, and deadlines are not known.

who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how federal rules apply to their products and services.
They appear to be directed to adjust how their rules and oversight cover fintech.
